items.question: When did Apollo 11 land on the Moon and who was on the crew?
reference_facts: Apollo 11 landed on the Moon on July 20, 1969
The crew was Neil Armstrong, Buzz Aldrin and Michael Collins

items.question: What did Chandrayaan-3 achieve?
reference_facts: Chandrayaan-3 achieved a soft landing on the Moon in August 2023
The lander was named Vikram and the rover was named Pragyan

items.question: Compare India's Chandrayaan-3 mission with NASA's Apollo 11 mission.
reference_facts: Apollo 11 was a crewed mission while Chandrayaan-3 was uncrewed
Apollo 11 landed in 1969 while Chandrayaan-3 landed in 2023

items.question: How do ISRO's Mars Orbiter Mission and ESA's Mars Express differ?
reference_facts: ISRO's Mars Orbiter Mission was launched in November 2013
ESA's Mars Express was launched in 2003

items.question: Which crater is the Perseverance rover exploring and what is it looking for?
reference_facts: It searches for signs of ancient microbial life

items.question: How has our understanding of liquid water on Mars changed over time?
reference_facts: Evidence indicates Mars once had liquid water on its surface
